path.description: Path of the config; null when it can't be located (see Config file).

state.description: State of the config; missing also when it can't be located.

root.description: Root path named by the config, cleaned and with ~/ expanded (the same form as notes_path); null if the config is missing, unreadable, doesn't parse, or names a root in an illegal form.

root_exists.description: Whether the root path leads, through symlinks, to a directory.

metadata.description: State of koan.json, per the three-step check (see File validity): corrupt fails step 1 or 3 (or is not a regular file), or is in an older format and breaks that format's rules; old-format fails step 2 with an older version, valid by its own rules, which migrate converts; unsupported-format fails step 2 with any other version, or passes every step but records a migration step past this binary's latest. ok says nothing about a step behind it: see migration_pending.

schema.description: koan.json's schema value; set whenever step 1 passes — whether metadata ends up ok, old-format, unsupported-format, or corrupt after step 1 — otherwise null.

migration.description: The migration step koan.json records: its migration when metadata is ok, or unsupported-format for a step past the latest; for old-format, what that format records (0 at schema 1, which predates migrations); otherwise null.

tree.description: State of the configured root; null when config.root is null.

path.description: Path of the state file, beside the config.

state.description: State of the state file, per the three-step check (see File validity). other-root: it is valid but names a root other than config.root, so this root has none. missing and other-root both make the root not initialized.

last_id.description: Highest task ID issued; null unless state is ok.

state.description: State of this machine's state file for the configured root; null when config.root is null.

initialized.description: True unless the root is not initialized (see Root states). True, with tree null, when the config exists but is unusable. A missing state file makes it false only once koan.json is ok: a root that needs migration is initialized.

usable.description: True when the root is usable (see Root states).

compatible.description: Whether tree.schema equals this binary's supported koan.json version (see Format versions); null when tree.schema is null.

migration_pending.description: Whether the root needs migration (see Root states): koan.json is old-format, or records a step behind this binary's latest. When true, run migrate. null when tree.migration is null.
